title: Equivariant Cellular Sheaves for Molecular Electronic Structure: Bridging Sheaf Cohomology and E(3)-Equivariant Hamiltonian Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.23571v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Equivariant message-passing networks are the standard model for molecular property and interatomic-potential prediction, and recent work predicts the electronic Hamiltonian itself in an E(3)-equivariant way. Separately, topological deep learning has extended graph networks to cellular sheaves. Our central observation is structural: in a localized atomic-orbital basis, the molecular single-particle Hamiltonian, after a constant shift that makes it positive semidefinite, is the Laplacian of a cellular sheaf on a regular cell complex built from the molecule. Making the restriction maps O(3)-steerable two-center kernels from bond geometry recovers the Slater-Koster form as a special case and yields an E(3)- and permutation-equivariant operator. Three consequences follow. First, the zeroth sheaf cohomology H^0 = ker L is a topological invariant equal to the non-bonding (zero-mode) orbitals, recovering the classical alternant non-bonding-orbit

translated_title: 等变细胞层用于分子电子结构：桥接层上同调与E(3)-等变哈密顿量学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23571v1 公告类型：新 摘要：等变消息传递网络是分子性质和原子间势预测的标准模型，最近的工作以E(3)-等变方式预测电子哈密顿量本身。另外，拓扑深度学习已将图网络扩展到细胞层。我们的核心观察是结构性的：在局域原子轨道基组中，分子单粒子哈密顿量，在常数平移使其成为半正定后，是建立在分子构建的正则胞复形上的细胞层的拉普拉斯算子。将限制映射设为来自键几何的O(3)-可转向双中心核，可恢复Slater-Koster形式作为特例，并产生E(3)-和置换等变算子。由此得出三个结果。首先，第零层上同调H^0 = ker L是一个拓扑不变量，等于非键（零模）轨道，恢复了经典的交替非键轨道。
tldr: 本文揭示了分子单粒子哈密顿量在局域原子轨道基下等价于细胞层拉普拉斯算子，从而将层上同调拓扑不变量与E(3)-等变哈密顿量学习统一，并恢复Slater-Koster形式。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the molecular single-particle Hamiltonian in a localized atomic-orbital basis is equivalent to the Laplacian of a cellular sheaf, unifying sheaf cohomology topological invariants with E(3)-equivariant Hamiltonian learning and recovering the Slater-Koster form.
